prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were overall too optimistic compared to noise-corrected results.
Path selection hints (choose_path, hint) consistently improved conversion, winning in both tests.
Adoption stage redesigns (3 tests) and path selection layout changes (2 tests) failed to improve conversion, with larger redesigns hurting performance.
Home wait_info changes (3 tests), sign-in reordering (2 tests), finish notifications (2 tests), finish hints (2 tests), and home notifications (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for single-test categories and categories without consistent agreement, including adoption layout/new_screen, choose_path copy/redesign, finish copy/layout/redesign, home hint/redesign, and sign_in copy/hint/redesign.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, hint] Path Choice Mascot Recommendation Hint: Display a hint below path options offering guidance on whether Instant Play or Custom Creator best fits the user. (why: Lessons learned show path selection hints consistently improved conversion in earlier tests, while choose_path drops 14.8% of users.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign In After Companion Selection: Move sign-in step to after adoption certificate screen so users pick and bond with their pet before signing in. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users early before they have created or chosen their pet.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Preparation Progress Time Indicator: Enable visual progress bars and estimated completion time on the waiting screen while assets build. (why: The waiting screen has a high median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing significant drop-off.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Instant Play Headline Focus: Update choose_path headline and body to emphasize fast zero-wait companion setup. (why: Improve decision speed and conversion on choose_path where 14.8% drop off.)
4: [finish, hint] Home Intro Desktop System Tray Hint: Add a persistent hint on the final screen explaining how to interact with and hide the desktop pet from the system tray. (why: 3 support tickets noted user confusion on how to control or hide the pet once setup finishes.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Sync Safety Hint: Display a hint on sign_in reassuring users that existing pet data automatically syncs across logins. (why: 8 support emails were received regarding lost or reset pets upon re-signing in.)

scores.note: Path hints consistently win across tests (+3.8% historical lift).
Sign-in reordering showed minimal effect and requires structural flow changes.
Home wait_info changes have consistently failed to improve conversion across 3 tests.
Copy tweak on path choice is cheap with moderate positive history (+1.6%).
Backed by support tickets on a high-drop step, but finish hints historically show minimal lift.
Strong evidence from both drop-off and 8 support emails; hint changes are low cost.
